jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer who can independently design, develop, test, and deploy end-to-end Agentic AI applications using React.js and Python.

You will be responsible for taking a business requirement, breaking it into modules, deciding the application architecture, designing data structures and APIs, integrating AI components, and delivering a fully functional, production-ready solution. Need someone who can think independently, make technical decisions, integrate services, and take complete ownership of the application lifecycle as a Indidual Contributor.

**Key Responsibilities**

* End-to-End Development: Build complete AI applications using React.js for the frontend and Python for the backend.
* Solution Design: Understand business requirements, divide work into modules, and define application architecture, data structures, and API requirements.
* Agentic AI Development: Integrate LLMs, RAG pipelines, AI agents, tool calling, and frameworks such as Lang Chain and Lang Graph.
* Service Integration: Integrate third-party APIs, databases, AI models, MCP servers, and other required services and protocols.
* Database Design: Design and manage relational databases and vector databases based on application requirements.
* Deployment & Infrastructure: Handle end-to-end deployment, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, cloud infrastructure, and production releases.

* Ownership & Communication: Work independently, communicate effectively with stakeholders, provide regular updates, and support off-hours activities when required by business needs.

* Strong hands-on experience with React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frontend development.
* Strong Python programming skills with experience in Fast API, Django, or similar backend frameworks.
* Practical experience building and deploying end-to-end AI applications.
* Good understanding of LLMs, RAG, vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI agent workflows.
* Experience with frameworks such as Lang Chain or Lang Graph.
* Understanding of MCP, tool calling, function calling, and API integrations.
* Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases, REST APIs, and data modelling.
* Experience with Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms, and production deployments.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹2,400,000.00 per year
